{"path": "mmio.py", "content": "import gpiod
# On the Pi 5 the GPIO controller is on the RP1 southbridge, not at the
# legacy mmio base. Use the Linux GPIO character device via libgpiod.
chip = gpiod.Chip('/dev/gpiochip4')
line = chip.get_line(17)
line.request(consumer='piforge', type=gpiod.LINE_REQ_DIR_OUT)
line.set_value(1)
line.release()
"}

text: Fixed: on the Pi 5 the GPIO controller is on the RP1 southbridge, so legacy /dev/mem mmio pokes at the old base miss. Rewrote the driver to use the Linux GPIO character device (/dev/gpiochip4) via libgpiod.
